## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was **sabotage code injected into the Python bz2 module** (`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/bz2.py`).

This caused all compression operations to fail with a simulated memory error, which is why the tests related to compression-based algorithms (BZ2NCD) were failing.

**Fix:** Removed the sabotage code (lines 347-349) from `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/bz2.py`, restoring the original `compress` function implementation.

After the fix, all 51 tests in the compression test suite pass successfully.
